unitTitle: Travel across the city and beyond
title: Grammar: Refer back to a place: y
subtitle: A2 · Unit 9: Travel across the city and beyond

steps.title: In this unit, y refers to a named place with aller or être. It goes before a conjugated verb, or before the infinitive when two verbs are used.
rows: Je vais retourner à la bibliothèque.
I am going to return there.

steps.title: Refer back to a place: y
steps.body:
• Name the place first, then use y to mean 'there': à la gare → nous y allons.
• Place y before its verb: j'y vais; elle y est. With a second verb, place it before the infinitive: je vais y retourner.
• In these patterns, y refers to a place, not a person. Compare je lui parle (to that person) and j'y vais (to that place).
• This unit practises y with common location patterns. Do not assume it replaces every phrase beginning with à.

steps.prompt: Nous allons à la bibliothèque. Nous ___ allons après le cours.
steps.explain: Y replaces the previously named place, à la bibliothèque.

steps.prompt: Nadia est au terminus. Nadia ___ est.
steps.explain: Use y to refer to the previously named place.

steps.prompt: Which sentence refers to a person?
steps.explain: Lui refers to the person being asked; y refers to a place in these examples.
